title: What If You Stood on the Rim of Mars's Giant Canyon?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Mars's giant canyon rim? The Grand Canyon looks tiny.
This canyon system on Mars runs for more than 3,000 kilometers. The Grand Canyon is only about 800.
The Grand Canyon is about 1.8 kilometers deep. Valles Marineris drops up to roughly seven kilometers.
Look straight down and the floor would sit about four times farther below you than at the Grand Canyon.
Across, it can stretch hundreds of kilometers, so the far wall might be hidden beyond the horizon.
The Grand Canyon is a famous wonder of Earth. On Mars, a canyon several times longer, wider and deeper is just one feature.

description:
What if you stood on the rim of Valles Marineris, the giant canyon on Mars?
It runs more than 3,000 kilometers and drops up to roughly seven, while the Grand Canyon is about 800 kilometers long and 1.8 deep.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Would you hike down it or just stare? Drop your own 'what if' below.
